mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals a weak labor market that may trigger short-term equity market pessimism, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, a 1% monthly increase in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In the post-recession recovery regime, INDPRO monthly change > 1.0% does not lead to positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase above 0.5% signals rising inflation, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls and decrease in unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE does not lead to positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, negative quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, GDPC1 quarterly growth < 0.0% does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
